stem: Which sentence shows that Chanute was more interested in developing a flying machine than in gaining fame for himself?

options.label: A
options.text: Alan B. Shepard, the first American in space, called Octave Chanute a remarkable man of vision. (paragraph 3)

options.label: B
options.text: He collected and studied materials on heavier-than-air flight. (paragraph 5)

options.label: C
options.text: He gave speeches, kept a diary, and carefully recorded the results of his own experiments. (paragraph 12)

options.label: D
options.text: But Chanute felt the conquest of flight was a tremendous task that required teamwork. (paragraph 13)
